# Asset

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Asset`](gmeow-Asset.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Asset>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A financial asset — a stock, bond, cryptocurrency, real estate holding, commodity, or other instrument of value. The thing that is held, not the holding itself (which is a [`Holding`](gmeow-Holding.md) relator).
